narration: What if the most interesting number in an AI IPO isn't the valuation? My analysis of Anthropic's 2026 filings looked at the fees it may be paying cloud distribution partners. The amended disclosures implied a fee around thirty-six percent under my assumptions. That is an estimate, not a disclosed contract rate. Distribution grows revenue, but its economics matter.
